Debian security tracker, trixie and trixie-security openssl 3.5.7-1~deb13u3: vulnerable, no fixed version. CMS_encrypt() loops forever on an EC recipient certificate of group order 1. From the distroless base image, which ships libssl3t64 3.5.7-1~deb13u3; nothing in the image loads the system libssl or libcrypto: a DT_NEEDED scan of every ELF in the pinned amd64 image (285 files, layers fetched by digest) finds libcrypto.so.3 only in libssl3t64's own libssl.so.3 and engines-3, node links neither (it bundles OpenSSL 3.5.9), and the API's production node_modules hold no ELF file. The API performs no CMS encryption.
